title: Great quality curtains
text: Great quality curtains. These curtains are really nice! They totally blackout the room when closed!  The material is a little thicker and has the white panel on the backside.  The panels seem to be really well made and all the stitching seems well done also.  It comes in a pack of 2 panels and is packaged really good so they aren't all wrinkled and you can hang them right up.  I would totally recommend these.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Room Darkening Blackout Window Curtain with Tie Back, 52 x 63 Inches, White - Set of 2

Machine washable for easy care; note: wrinkles from packing will go away after hanging or ironing
